decisions.reason: Posted 11 Jun 2026 against the final guidance, about two years after it was issued; cannot bear on draft-to-final changes. Near-identical text from the same individual.

Body is only 'See attached file(s)'; the 3 attachments are third-party reference documents (21 CFR 10.115, CDER MAPP 4100.2, AHRQ Future Research Needs Paper No. 13) that do not address the draft guidance. Counted under 'who commented'; contributes zero asks to theming. FDA lists the record as 3 identical submissions.

Use the current fda.gov copy as the final. It matches the Jul 2024 docket copy (FDA-2020-D-2307-0067) except one post-publication edit in V.E.2: 'age, gender, race' -> 'age, sex, race'. Note this in outputs.

decisions.notes: All 7 low-confidence calls accepted as proposed: Wound Care Alliance=Professional society; MS Trials Committee=Academic; Invitae=Data & tech vendor; Guardant=Data & tech vendor; Anthem/HealthCore=Other (payer); AHA=Patient advocacy; National Health Council=Patient advocacy. Medium calls accepted.

12 themes. Edits: T02 'fit for purpose' wording; draft T13 (study design & analytic methods) folded into T03 as 'Methodology'. Non-constructive comments (sales pitch, general support, praise + citations) will carry zero or few asks, as intended.
NHC 'patient engagement & public communication' T99 proposals (A02, A06) folded into T10; no new theme.
Within a comment, a reiterated point counts once unless a later instance makes a genuinely section-specific point. Applied to all 57 coded comments.
Asks with no draft_section are treated as general comments on the guidance as a whole.
